Kids Calendar

Kids Calendar (age 12 & under)

September 2026

Key to Locations

AADL: Ann Arbor District Library, (734) 327-4200, aadl.org.

HSHV: Humane Society of Huron Valley, 3100 Cherry Hill Rd.

★ Free

Events

★ Every Mon.–Fri. (different times): Preschool Storytimes: AADL. Half-hour program of stories and songs for kids ages 2–5 (with caregiver). Pittsfield (Mon. 10:30 a.m.), Downtown (Tues. 11 a.m.), Malletts Creek (Tues. 11 a.m. & Wed. 10:30 a.m.), Traverwood (Thurs. 11 a.m.), and Westgate (Fri. 1 p.m.).

★ Sept. 4 (1–2 p.m.): “Tech Take-Apart”: AADL Downtown. Kids grade 2 & up invited to take apart toasters, keyboards, and other small devices to try to find out how they work. Younger children require adult assistance.

Sept. 11 (5:30–8:30 p.m.): “Pets and Pajamas Movie Night”: HSHV. Kids ages 6–11 invited to watch an animal-themed movie and interact with adoptable pets. Cheese pizza dinner. $35 per child. Preregistration required at hshv.org/event-calendar.

★ Sept. 13 (11 a.m.): “Tales from Detroit”: Flying Cardboard Theater (University Musical Society Ypsi Freighthouse Residency). Members of this Detroit puppet company perform a puppet play, then lead kids ages 5–18 & their families in a workshop. 100 Market Pl., Ypsi. Tickets $5 in advance.

★ Sept. 14 & 16 (10:30–11 a.m.) and Sept. 15 (1:30–2 p.m.): “Preschool ArtStart”: AADL. AADL staff lead children ages 2–5, accompanied by an adult, in arts and crafts, with an emphasis on fun.

★ Sept. 15, 22, & 29 (10:30–11:30 a.m.): “Outdoor Story Time”: Ann Arbor Parks & Recreation. Kids ages 2–5 invited, accompanied by an adult, for stories, play, and crafts on a theme. Free, preregistration required at tinyurl.com/a2parksrec.

★ Sept. 19 (10 a.m.-noon): Fall Open House: Faber Piano Institute. Kids ages 5 & 6 invited to play music games, make crafts, and learn to play a tune on the keyboard. 3042 Creek Dr.

Sept. 22 (11–11:30 a.m.): “Little Story Party: Dino Party”: Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum. Museum staff read a dinosaur story TBA, then lead a short hands-on activity inspired by the book. $16 museum admission.
